comparison.objective: Index a Geneva drive twice and prove its dwell.
comparison.physical_skill: Driving a contact-mediated intermittent mechanism through engagement and dwell.
comparison.success_condition: Two valid indexing cycles followed by stable dwell and both hands released.
comparison.reason: Both verify articulated behavior, but Geneva indexing tests roller-slot transmission rather than preserving a calibrated stop through jam-nut countertorque.
